messages:

Cc: Microsoft Partner Center <pc-referrals@microsoft.com>

Subject: Incoming Partner Center referral: BrightWorks (PC-9421-AZ)

Hi Dylan + Marissa,

Partner Center just pushed a referral for BrightWorks (PC-9421-AZ). Quick summary below: 
- Company: BrightWorks Inc. (marketing analytics)
- ARR/ACV: ~$120k expected first-year consumption via Azure consumption SKUs
- Contact: Samir Shah (VP Product) <samir@brightworks.com>
- Referral source: AcmePartners (Lena Ortiz) via Partner Center
- Referral details: marketplace listing interest + co-sell assistance requested

Link: https://partnercenter.microsoft.com/referrals/PC-9421-AZ
Attachment: referral-9421.pdf (partner-submitted brief)

Can you confirm who owns this? Acme expects Redwood to pick a field seller (co-sell lead) for follow-up; they also indicated BrightWorks has had a previous trial contact with Redwood but no active AE. We want to avoid duplicate outreach and make sure the partner gets clear next steps (P0: contact within 24h).

Lena
Acme Partners

---
Note: I looped PC so their ops team sees the thread for routing telemetry.

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Incoming Partner Center referral: BrightWorks (PC-9421-AZ)

Thanks Lena — I got it. Internal proposal for routing and ownership (please review/fix):

Goal: deterministic, fast routing that respects existing seller coverage and maximizes co-sell credit while avoiding noisy outreach.

Proposed owner assignment rules (evaluate in this order):
1) Existing Redwood AE in HubSpot/CRM that had contact within last 12 months -> assign to that AE.
2) If no active AE, check if the partner (Acme) has an assigned GTM co-sell seller in the same region -> assign to that seller (Marissa suggested as regional fallback).
3) If neither exists, assign to the Azure PC "partner-referrals" queue for triage and auto-assign to the primary AE on rotation (24h SLA).
4) If multiple internal sellers claim coverage, tie-break by: a) highest recent engagement score with account, b) most recent contact timestamp, c) any explicit mutual action plan in CRM.

Operational notes:
- Mark the record with tag: "azure-pc-referral" and HubSpot owner field.
- Add the referral id (PC-9421-AZ) to the HubSpot deal and to the Redwood deal notes.
- If partner submitted via Partner Center (they did), ensure we acknowledge to PC ops within 4 business hours.

I've attached a starter mapping CSV with suggested owner mappings for similar accounts; see marketplace-mapping-table.csv.

Asks: 
- Marissa: can you confirm willingness to take BrightWorks as primary if you have capacity?
- Karthik: any constraints on quoting/marketplace SKUs we should pre-flag (pricing floor / required MSA)?
- Soojin: can you confirm HubSpot pipeline and Partner Center acknowledgement steps we should automate?

If we agree, I will: 1) update HubSpot, 2) send Samir a short intro + proposed 24h call window, 3) post an acknowledgement to PC ops.

Thanks,
Dylan
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: marketplace-mapping-table.csv]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Incoming Partner Center referral: BrightWorks (PC-9421-AZ)

Looping in quick commercial notes. TL;DR: set expectations with partner/customer on licensing path + pricing cadence before deep technical.

- Marketplace vs co-sell: if BrightWorks intends to transact via Azure Marketplace (consumption), we need to map the intended SKUs to our marketplace listings. That impacts the co-sell approval path and how revenue is tracked for Microsoft crediting.
- Pricing: for a first-year ARR ~120k, offer guidance on typical discount bands for marketplace customers (we generally keep marketplace price within standard published list; deeper discounts require procurement approval).
- Contracting: encourage early MSA + SOW conversation, but marketplace purchases can proceed without upfront MSA depending on customer risk appetite. If BrightWorks requires an enterprise contract, Ops will want a flagged procurement ticket. 

Action items for this thread: 
1) Add a short commercial note in the HubSpot deal: "intent: marketplace_consumption / needs MSA? yes/no".
2) If partner expects us to handle co-sell enablement with Microsoft, mark deal as "co-sell enabled" and notify Vanessa to start co-sell playbook.

I can draft the pricing guidance memo once owner is confirmed.

Karthik
VP, Cloud Partnerships & GTM
Redwood Inference

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Microsoft Partner Center <pc-referrals@microsoft.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Incoming Partner Center referral: BrightWorks (PC-9421-AZ)

Operational details from partner-center side: we see PC record PC-9421-AZ (status: Submitted -> Needs Assignment). Two quick ops notes: 

1) Partner Center auto-assign currently pushes to our generic PC queue. We can change auto-assign rules to check CRM owner field first, but that requires a small integration update (~3 dev days). Until then, we should triage from the PC queue.

2) HubSpot pipeline: create dedicated pipeline "Azure PC Referrals" with these fields: referral_id, partner, partner_submission, azure_region, expected_ARR, marketplace_intent, co-sell_enabled, owner_proposed. Please tag the PC record with HubSpot id HO-9421 (link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/record/HO-9421).

3) Dedupe logic: if PC finds a previously-submitted referral for the same domain, PC will flag but not block. Our triage must check for domain matches and for existing deals in last 24 months. Use the following tie-break rule for duplicates: prefer existing open deal > existing past deal with engagement > new referral.

I exported the PC JSON (referral-9421.json) and attached it. I'll open a Jira ticket for the auto-assign integration (JIRA: INF-2319).

Soojinn
Marketplace Ops
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: referral-9421.json]
